title: TOPOVIBL function in meiotic DSB formation: new insights from its biochemical and structural characterization
authors: Diagouraga B; Tambones I; Carivenc C; Bechara C; de Massy B; le Maire A; Robert T
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生化与结构表征研究TOPOVIBL蛋白与DNA的互作及动态构象，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作机制，可为TF-DNA结合建模提供参考。
abstract: The TOPOVIL complex catalyzes the formation of DNA double strand breaks (DSB) that initiate meiotic homologous recombination, an essential step for chromosome segregation and genetic diversity during gamete production. TOPOVIL is composed of two subunits (SPO11 and TOPOVIBL) and is evolutionarily related to the archaeal TopoVI topoisomerase complex. SPO11 is the TopoVIA subunit orthologue and carries the DSB formation catalytic activity. TOPOVIBL shares homology with the TopoVIB ATPase subunit. TOPOVIBL is essential for meiotic DSB formation, but its molecular function remains elusive, partly due to the lack of biochemical studies. Here, we purified TOPOVIBLΔC25 and characterized its structure and mode of action in vitro . Our structural analysis revealed that TOPOVIBLΔC25 adopts a dynamic conformation in solution and our biochemical study showed that the protein remains monomeric upon incubation with ATP, which correlates with the absence of ATP binding. Moreover, TOPOVIBLΔC25 interacted with DNA, with a preference for some geometries, suggesting that TOPOVIBL senses specific DNA architectures. Altogether, our study identified specific TOPOVIBL features that might help to explain how TOPOVIL function evolved toward a DSB formation activity in meiosis.
abstract_zh: TOPOVIL复合物催化DNA双链断裂（DSB）的形成，该断裂启动减数分裂同源重组，这是配子产生过程中染色体分离和遗传多样性的关键步骤。TOPOVIL由两个亚基（SPO11和TOPOVIBL）组成，在进化上与古菌TopoVI拓扑异构酶复合物相关。SPO11是TopoVIA亚基的直系同源物，并携带DSB形成的催化活性。TOPOVIBL与TopoVIB ATP酶亚基具有同源性。TOPOVIBL对减数分裂DSB形成至关重要，但其分子功能仍不明确，部分原因在于缺乏生化研究。在此，我们纯化了TOPOVIBLΔC25，并在体外表征了其结构和作用模式。我们的结构分析显示，TOPOVIBLΔC25在溶液中采用动态构象，而我们的生化研究表明，该蛋白在与ATP孵育时保持单体状态，这与ATP结合缺失相关。此外，TOPOVIBLΔC25与DNA相互作用，并对某些几何结构具有偏好性，这表明TOPOVIBL能感知特定的DNA架构。总体而言，我们的研究识别了TOPOVIBL的特定特征，这可能有助于解释TOPOVIL功能如何进化为减数分裂中的DSB形成活性。
